verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents running many local LLMs (gpt-oss, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi) downloaded from Hugging Face. It serves embeddings via llama.cpp and Apple MLX backends, which covers the LLM and embedding parts of the story. The evidence does not label any model as MoE, never mentions multi-modal/vision support, and never claims 'hundreds' of architectures; one community report says some Hugging Face models aren't listed. Missing for 10: explicit multi-modal model support, explicit MoE architecture support, evidence of breadth across hundreds of architectures, independent corroboration of embedding/multimodal use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models
